technique_name: Compare and contrast Object-Oriented Programming and Functional Programming.
description:
Object-oriented programming (OOP) and functional programming (FP) are two distinct programming paradigms that have different approaches to the development and structure of software programs. 

In OOP, the focus is on creating objects, which are interfaces to real-world entities and data structured data.
